x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.guidance_text: On a critical unauthorized transaction, immediately block the card, reset online-banking credentials, and open a chargeback. Escalate suspected account takeover to the fraud lead and file a SAR where thresholds are met.
x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.keywords: unauthorized, fraud, account takeover, card block, containment, SAR
